instruction.text: Match the description of the different stages in the courgette plant’s life cycle with the correct photo.

hint.text: Germination is the process through which a seed begins to sprout.
hint.label: Germination

a.sound: The life cycle of a courgette starts with a seed. Under the right conditions, these tiny seeds will germinate and grow into a plant with lots of yummy courgettes.
Once the seeds sprout, each plant grows yellow flowers.
If the right flower gets pollinated, a courgette will start to grow and can soon be harvested.

instruction.text: Complete the courgette plant’s life cycle by dragging the pictures into the correct gaps.

feedback.correct: Well done! The courgette plant goes through an incredible transformation while growing from a tiny seed into an adult plant full of courgettes.

instruction.text: Is the statement true or false? Select the correct answer.

atoms.a: Courgette plants experience pollination in their life cycle.
Besides growing more leaves, the plant doesn’t change that much from germination to mature plant.
Once the seeds germinate, they start to grow roots.
Courgette plants only need fresh air to grow.
Courgette plants make their own food through photosynthesis.
